title: HCMC Marathon 2027 Review: Pulse Active's Flagship Run Through Saigon
seo_title: HCMC Marathon 2027 Review | Ho Chi Minh City Marathon Guide
meta_description: The HCMC Marathon 2027 is set for January 17 at 30/4 Park, Ho Chi Minh City. Full marathon, half, and 10K from Pulse Active, registration now open -- Vietnam's biggest city marathon, reviewed.
dek: Set for 17 January 2027 starting at 30/4 Park on Le Duan Street in Ho Chi Minh City, this Pulse Active-organised marathon offers full (42K), half (21K), and 10K distances — and registration is already open. Here's what to expect from one of Vietnam's most established urban road races.
verdict: The HCMC Marathon is one of Vietnam's anchor road races — a Pulse Active production that has grown into a fixture on the country's running calendar, anchored at the iconic 30/4 Park in the heart of District 1. Three distances from 10K to the full 42.195km make it accessible across abilities, and the fact that registration is already open — for a January 2027 race — signals an organiser with its operational timeline in order. The course threads through Saigon's central districts, past the Notre-Dame Cathedral, the Reunification Palace, and along the Saigon River, though city traffic means some sections share the road with morning motorbikes. Suits runners who want a big-city Vietnamese marathon with established organisation and a genuine urban atmosphere.

sections.heading: The Course: District 1 and the Heart of Saigon
paragraphs: The race starts and finishes at 30/4 Park on Le Duan Street, directly opposite the Reunification Palace in District 1 — as central a start line as Ho Chi Minh City can offer. [1] The course routes through the city's widest boulevards, past the Notre-Dame Cathedral, the Central Post Office, and along the Saigon River in the early kilometres before expanding into the outer districts for the full marathon distance. It's predominantly flat, as befits a Mekong Delta city, with bridge crossings over the canals providing the only meaningful elevation.

sections.heading: The Organiser: Pulse Active
paragraphs: Pulse Active is one of Vietnam's most established race organisers, with a portfolio that spans multiple distances and cities — including the VPBank Hanoi International Marathon and the HCMC Music Half Marathon. [1] That track record means runners can expect professional timing, well-stocked aid stations, and a race-day operation that's been refined across multiple editions. The January date is well-chosen: Ho Chi Minh City's dry season runs from December through April, and a mid-January morning offers temperatures in the low-to-mid 20s Celsius with manageable humidity.

sections.heading: Registration: Open Now
paragraphs: Registration is currently open via hcmcmarathon.com, with three distances available: full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), and 10km. [1] The open registration window — for a race nearly a year out — is a strong signal that Pulse Active is running a well-oiled operation. Early-bird pricing is typically available for the first registration tranche.
